name: table-33
description: A shopping cart table with quantity steppers, line totals, and a footer total.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Minus as MinusIcon, Plus as PlusIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const initialCart = [ { id: "a", name: "Portfolio template", price: 49 }, { id: "b", name: "Icons Pro license", price: 29 }, { id: "c", name: "Logos pack", price: 9 }, ] export default function CartSummaryTable() { const [qty, setQty] = React.useState>({ a: 1, b: 2, c: 3, }) const total = initialCart.reduce( (s, item) => s + item.price * (qty[item.id] ?? 0), 0 ) const change = (id: string, d: number) => setQty((q) => ({ ...q, [id]: Math.max(0, (q[id] ?? 0) + d) })) return (
Item Qty Total {initialCart.map((item) => (

{item.name}

{"$" + item.price.toFixed(2)} each

{qty[item.id]}
{"$" + (item.price * (qty[item.id] ?? 0)).toFixed(2)} ))} Subtotal {"$" + total.toFixed(2)}
) }
